About Market is Online

A marketplace. Your account. One place.

Learn how the Market is Online marketplace, seller centre and member account work together.

Shop across the marketplace

Browse products from participating sellers, review product details and add items to your cart. The checkout shows the available payment options and order total before you place an order.

Manage your membership

Your member dashboard brings together your profile, wallet activity, orders, network and qualification progress. Package requirements, point values and available benefits are shown in the account using the current programme settings.

Sell on Market is Online

Sellers submit an application with their business details and country. Approved sellers can create and manage product listings through the Seller Centre. Products are reviewed before publication.

Need help?

Use the support page for account or order assistance. Refer to the details shown for your order and current programme rules when reviewing payments or rewards.
